[[File:Throneroomantechamber.png|thumb|150px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] striding across the Supplicants Waiting Hall]]
The '''Supplicants Waiting Hall''' was a waiting area immediately outside [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Imperial Throne Room|throne room]] within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Those waiting for an audience with the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] lined up in the Supplicants Waiting Hall until their master was ready to see them.<ref name="ITES">{{WEGCite|story=In the Emperor's Service|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> It was a long corridor lined with stone columns with [[Window/Legends|windows]] in between.<ref name="VQ2">[[Vader's Quest 2|''Vader's Quest'' 2]]</ref>
